llm_response.reason: The URL 'support-center.fb-business.com' closely mimics legitimate Meta/Facebook support channels and has been reported in credible sources as a phishing scam that threatens Facebook business owners with account suspension, prompting them to enter credentials. Tactics include spoofing Meta branding (16), leveraging urgency and psychological pressure (3, 13), and misleading about legitimate company affiliations (4). Official Facebook/Meta support documents warn users to avoid such domains. The inaccessible site (403) is also characteristic of takedown or blocking for malicious domains.
